note: Careless violence (brief 013 D), the twin of route-b: the idle Enforcer kills guard 73 (p-records-office-73, the incoming door guard) on his walk from the café to the public door and leaves him where he fell. c038 (Waymark, engine 0.34.1): his walk now runs 3.5 m south of the old spot (walks off the grid since 0.33.0), so the Enforcer waits 1.2 m beside the new line at (33.0, -40.1); the kill (about 4:30) is timed to his arrival, the first tick he is in reach, from the side, unseen. His missed 5:30 mark is the desk's report (Alert 1), which no Tech action stops; nobody finds the body before the car leaves, so the debrief carries a missing person and an open case: a win at Alert 1 (route-b: Alert 0) and dearer in total Trail (MC-7).
